user.title: The Frame Controller
user.description: Enter the URL of the running theframe-controller add-on. From inside Home Assistant the add-on is usually reachable at {default_url}.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure The Frame
reconfigure.description: Update the URL of the theframe-controller add-on. Use this if the add-on moved to a different host or port. Existing entities and their history are preserved.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the add-on. Check that it is running and that the URL is correct.

abort.already_configured: This add-on URL is already configured.

init.title: The Frame options
init.description:
Hidden keywords: a comma-separated list of keywords to hide from this integration. Useful for marker tags like "TheFrame" or "exportiert" that you maintain in your photo library for housekeeping but that don't need their own switch / media-browser folder. Hidden keywords also disappear from per-file metadata and from the collections editor.

HomeKit: new, renamed or deleted collections normally reach Apple Home on their own. If they don't, turn this on: every HomeKit bridge that shows the collection select then reloads 30 seconds after the last change.

data.reload_homekit: Reload the HomeKit bridge when collections change
